Counter check: page claims 'Total Shipments 2156 Records detected' and 'Trading Partners 15', but only 5 individual shipment rows are rendered in the free view (2 of them outbound exports, 3 inbound imports) — the 2156 figure is not verifiable row-by-row.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report domestic split was retrievable: DuckDuckGo search backend returned 'no results (searx: <urlopen error [Errno 111] Connection refused>)' on both queries, and volza/eximpedia/trademo free views returned HTTP 403. Only indirect domestic signal: the same ImportKey page lists Indian counterparties in the buyer/supplier tables ('PADMAVATI INTERNATIONAL PVT LTD', 'PRIGAN INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED', 'AADIDEV AUTO CARE', 'R K MANOJ & CO', 'ALP OVERSEAS PRIVATE LIMITED') and Indian ports 'MUNDRA SEA 59', 'TUGLAKABAD ICD 21' — these are trade counterparties/port lanes, not GST or contract evidence, so domestic supply is not confirmed.
note: Declared HS 392690 (plastic articles) does not match the observed shipment HS codes: exports are 87089900 (auto parts/headlamp kits) and 39199020 (self-adhesive plastic film), imports are 39219099 (PET/ALU/PET/PE membrane foil), 85169000 (PCB for mosquito racket) and 39199020. Per project rule 3 this is NOT a rejection ground — company stays in the base, actual HS should be corrected to the observed codes (87089900 / 39199020 / 39219099) with verdict accepted_hs_corrected. Export activity is factually confirmed by dated customs rows with destination and B/L numbers (South Africa 2026-02-13 B/L 9657270; Nepal 2026-02-19 B/L 9812649), so this is not a 'declared only' case. Role looks like manufacturer_trader (imports raw film/PCB and re-exports finished auto accessories), but that is an inference from the goods flow, not a registry fact. Revenue and export volume: null — not public in the free views. Domestic supply: no GST/tender/contract evidence found; search tooling was unavailable, so status is unknown rather than none_found.
